description.value: Dharma Garden Veggie Deli is a Vietnamese vegetarian deli and restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver, also known by its Vietnamese name Quán Chay Pháp Uyển. Its all-vegetarian Vietnamese menu makes it a distinctive stop for plant-based touring cyclists passing through the city. The business operates in both English and Vietnamese, reflecting the culturally diverse neighbourhood it serves.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 28m; stands (2 spaces) at 49m; rack (4 spaces) at 75m; rack at 88m; rack at 97m. Total: 6 spaces.
